description: List the perfumes and colognes in the 10ML Fragrance Index built around a note or ingredient (vanilla, oud, bergamot, tonka bean, jasmine, patchouli, leather, sandalwood...), most prominent first, optionally only where the note sits in the top, heart or base, or for an audience, season or occasion. Spelling variants and other languages work (agarwood finds oud, Vanille finds vanilla). Use for 'perfumes with oud', 'a vanilla scent for winter' or 'bergamot-forward colognes for men'. Not for explaining what a note smells like (use explain_note) and not for several notes at once (use search_perfumes with notes_include).

gender.description: Audience the perfume is marketed to. men and women also include unisex perfumes.

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

position.description: Where the note sits in the pyramid: top, heart, base or any

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

season.description: Season the perfume suits (fall is accepted in text queries as autumn).

name: perfumes_by_note
title: Perfumes by note
